title: Can AI keep your receipts? What the IRS still wants
label: AI and your taxes

hook.text: Can *AI* keep your receipts for the IRS?
hook.sub: What it can do, and what it can't.

items.l: Prove it if the IRS asks

beats.text: Receipts, invoices and paid bills that *support* each entry.
beats.sub: For meals and travel, write down who and why.

beats.note: Longer in some cases, like unreported income.

beats.text: Let AI scan. *You* add the note.
beats.sub: A human check before tax time.

cta.sub: We'll DM you our bookkeeping checklist.

captions.instagram:
Can AI keep your receipts for the IRS? Partly.

✔️ AI apps can scan a receipt, read the amount and date, and suggest a category.
✔️ They can't know the business reason. For meals and travel, write down who you met and why.
✔️ The IRS wants supporting documents for your entries: receipts, invoices, paid bills, deposit slips.
✔️ Keep records generally for 3 years from the date you filed, and longer in some cases.

Let AI do the scanning, add your note, and have a human review the books before tax time.

Source: IRS, What kind of records should I keep; How long should I keep records; Publication 463. General information, not advice for your situation.
